Spend £75 or more on qualifying STANLEY or STANLEY FATMAX hand tools or storage products to claim a FREE STANLEY FATMAX XTREME 120cm Box Beam Level (FMHT43676-1). UK & ROI residents aged 18+ only. Purchase on or between 01.09.2026 - 24.11.2026. Claim online at STANLEYtools.co.uk by 07.12.2026 with proof of purchase. 5,000 available, first come, first served. Full T&Cs apply. Manufacturer promotion.

This Stanley 19-inch plastic tool box provides robust and portable storage for hand tools and small components. Engineered for trade professionals and DIY enthusiasts requiring reliable equipment on site or in the workshop, it features a durable plastic construction with a hinged lid secured by strong metal clamps. Inside, a large main compartment is complemented by a removable tote tray for easy access to frequently used items, alongside two integrated organisers in the lid for screws, fixings, and smaller accessories. Its water-resistant design protects contents from damp conditions, making it suitable for various working environments. A comfortable carrying handle ensures easy transportation, with a load capacity of up to an 8 kg.
